metadata.title: SPARC Azure Container App Environment Component Definition

components.title: Azure Container App Environment
components.description: The managed, VNet-integrated environment hosting the SPARC container app, with a bound Log Analytics workspace. Deployed via Terraform (Azure/ACK/modules/container_app_environment/). <!-- UPDATE: insert the environment resource ID and default domain. -->

control-implementations.description: NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 control implementations for the Container App Environment

implemented-requirements.description: Boundary Protection: The environment is injected into a dedicated infrastructure subnet delegated to Microsoft.App/environments, keeping app egress on the VNet with the private data tier. Reference: DISA SRG-NET-000364.
Event Logging: A Log Analytics workspace is bound to the environment so all container app logs and metrics are centrally retained. Reference: DISA SRG-APP-000089.
